title: The specified native scalar tensor chain square
statement: For finite R, p:X→Y and fixed-scalar cochain complexes P,Q, the scalar realization of fixed-coefficient tensor pullback, followed by scalar total realization after pullback and the total tensor map of the two inverse scalar comparisons, equals the inverse scalar comparison at the total tensor followed by intrinsic pullback of total realization and the intrinsic total tensor pullback comparison. This is the exact equality of the original native chain maps before degree evaluation.

proof.text: Rewrite the three original native left maps by their separately proved tuple-projection identifications, and the original right composite by its separately proved native-path identification. These are equalities of the exact cochain maps and preserve their native types.
Apply the proved equality of the named native paths. That equality is the proved cochain-diagram commutativity with its explicitly constructed data projections reduced, before any degree evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarTensorPullback_native_chain_square
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ) :
    ((((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((finiteScalarFixedComplexTensorPullbackForCoefficients
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).app (P, Q))) ≫
      (finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalRealization R X).app
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P,
         ((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
      (uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)).map₂HomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app P)
          ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app Q))) =
    ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app
        ((finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalTensor
          (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)))).obj (P, Q)) ≫
      ((proEtaleRingModulePullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
          (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).map ((finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalRealization R Y).app (P, Q)) ≫
      (finiteScalarIntrinsicComplexTensorPullback R p).app
        (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P,
         ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
